approval_required_for: Any change to Qwen2 decoder semantics, including GQA head mapping, KV grouping, RoPE theta, causal masking, or sequence bound.
Any change to numeric policy, fp16/fp32 cast points, residual precision, rounding mode, saturation policy, or numeric tolerance thresholds.
Any change to decoder-block operator order, residual_add_1/residual_add_2 placement, RMSNorm placement, MLP gate/up/activation/down ordering, or stream/lane ordering.
Any memory layout, DDR image, manifest packing, runtime ABI, or transfer-unit change that affects the testbench-to-runtime contract.
Any major template or RTL architecture modification beyond bounded repair localized by boundary trace and targeted replay.
Any decision to reopen a previously passed lower-layer gate without contradictory boundary-trace evidence.

executable_actions.on_failure: Hold the single-layer merge plan in verification_artifacts; repair only the contract/DAG inconsistency and do not launch leaf or layer simulation gates.
executable_actions.rationale: Produce the role-owned single-layer gate DAG and contracts from the supplied Stage 3 attention semantics, Stage 4 numeric binding, Stage 5 generated package, and verification artifact contract without claiming execution pass.

executable_actions.on_failure: Block case_leaf_functional and case_tb_scaffold; classify missing or non-real artifacts as test/golden artifact repair, not hardware failure.
executable_actions.rationale: Functional verification requires run-specific real input and weight artifacts; deterministic default/generated weights are explicitly not acceptance evidence.

executable_actions.on_failure: Do not promote merge.self_attention, merge.mlp, or merge.single_decoder_block; route failed leaf evidence to bounded failure slicing at the earliest violated boundary.
executable_actions.rationale: The single layer cannot be merged until all nine operator leaves have static evidence, boundary contracts, independent functional simulation, and golden comparison evidence.

executable_actions.on_failure: Treat the failure as scaffold or tool-protocol repair; do not reinterpret leaf or layer RTL correctness without contradictory boundary evidence.
executable_actions.rationale: The layer functional simulator must use a reproducible scaffold that loads the declared real manifests and verified leaf interfaces by deterministic hash.

executable_actions.on_failure: Block layer functional simulation and localize whether the mismatch is at self-attention, MLP, residual, norm, stream, or cast boundary before repair handoff.
executable_actions.rationale: Connect verified leaves into the single decoder block while preserving Qwen2 GQA semantics, residual_add_1/residual_add_2 placement, RMSNorm ordering, MLP gate/up/activation/down order, stream order, and numeric cast points.

executable_actions.on_failure: Do not proceed to case_single_layer_golden_compare or board/multilayer gates; run boundary-trace failure localization and targeted replay using the debug closure contract.
executable_actions.rationale: The connected single transformer-layer kernel must pass real functional simulation with real manifests, watchdog evidence, and trace capture before any multilayer or board wrapper handoff.

executable_actions.on_failure: Freeze the failed outputs and reference hashes; invoke bounded failure slicing without modifying golden outputs or loosening tolerance.
executable_actions.rationale: A functional simulation run is not sufficient; the single-layer outputs must be compared against the golden/reference behavior under the frozen numeric tolerance and stream order contracts.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep the layer gate blocked and request checker or trace-schema repair; do not apply RTL, pipeline, numeric, or template changes without localized evidence and required approval.
executable_actions.rationale: Any failed leaf or single-layer gate must enter the tool-output to contract-guided localization to bounded repair handoff loop, identifying the earliest violated boundary before proposing code repair.

executable_actions.on_failure: Do not let board AXI/DDR or backend planners consume the single-layer package; report the missing checker evidence or failed gate as the handoff blocker.
executable_actions.rationale: Only after single-layer functional and golden gates pass should downstream board AXI/DDR planning and repair-boundary audit consume a compact, checker-grounded readiness contract.

observations: The supplied state summary reports zero active contamination barriers and zero open retry or backtrack requests; no historical blocker should be inferred for this stage.
The verification artifact contract is marked pass and declares the three-layer repair hierarchy: operator leaf modules, single transformer-layer kernel, and board AXI/DDR wrapped system.

The current role scope is the second repair-loop layer only: merge verified leaves into one Qwen2 decoder-block kernel and hand off a readiness contract, without claiming multilayer, AXI/DDR, Vivado, or board readiness.

All relevant real-tool gates for this role are still required_pending_execution: case_real_weight_artifacts, case_stage_leaf_static, boundary_contract_check, case_leaf_functional, case_leaf_golden_compare, case_tb_scaffold, single_transformer_layer, case_single_layer_functional, and case_single_layer_golden_compare.

Stage 3 attention semantics establish GQA with 14 query heads, 2 KV heads, group size 7, head_dim 64, seq_len_bound 16, RoPE theta 1000000.0, and causal ordering; these semantics must be preserved through merge.self_attention and the single decoder block.

Stage 4 numeric binding establishes fp16 weights and activations, fp32 accumulation/residual precision, nearest_even rounding, no saturation, and explicit cast points around RMSNorm, attention output, MLP down projection, and residual additions.

The role_slice_policy prevents treating compactly omitted rows as missing: presence_summary confirms nine stage agents, nine parameter bindings, thirteen debug boundary contracts, and a debug trace schema.
Stage 5 compile/elaboration and contract checks passed for generated code, but those are structural/tool-evidence prerequisites only and are not functional correctness evidence.

The debug closure contract already defines boundary trace fields, targeted replay outputs, and earliest-violation localization; single-layer failures should use this contract before any RTL repair proposal.
The functional_sim_candidates explicitly mark liveness-only VCS labels as non-acceptance; the single-layer gate must require real functional simulation plus golden/numeric comparison.
proposed_actions: Emit the single-layer sub-DAG and merge contract that explicitly orders real-weight artifacts, leaf closure, scaffold generation, single-layer merge, functional simulation, golden comparison, and failure slicing.
Materialize and hash real input, weight, and DDR-image manifests before any functional simulation or testbench acceptance.
Close all nine operator leaf gates with static checks, boundary contracts, independent functional simulation, and leaf golden comparison before promoting merge.self_attention or merge.mlp.
Generate a reproducible testbench scaffold only after real artifacts and leaf golden evidence exist; audit that it loads declared manifests by hash.
Build the single_transformer_layer merge using the verified leaf matrix while checking Qwen2 GQA semantics, residual ordering, stream/lane order, and numeric cast points.
Run real single-layer functional simulation with watchdog and trace collection; do not accept smoke or liveness-only output.
Run single-layer golden comparison with numeric_compare and data_order_trace_check using the frozen numeric tolerance plan.
On any failed leaf or single-layer gate, run boundary-trace localization and targeted replay to produce a compact causal repair context before any bounded repair handoff.
After case_single_layer_golden_compare passes, emit a readiness handoff for verification_artifacts.board_axi_ddr_system_planner and verification_artifacts.repair_boundary_evidence_auditor.
risks: Execution risk, not a current static-stage blocker: real input and real weight artifacts have not yet been materialized, so default generated weights must not be accepted as functional evidence.
GQA head-to-KV grouping, RoPE position ordering, causal mask behavior, and stream/lane ordering can drift at the self-attention merge boundary even when individual leaves pass.
Numeric drift can occur if fp16/fp32 cast points or residual precision are not reflected identically in the testbench, golden reference, and RTL trace; tolerance changes require explicit approval.
A liveness-only simulator result could be mislabeled as a functional pass unless case_single_layer_functional is tied to real manifests, trace evidence, and downstream numeric comparison.
A single-layer mismatch may originate from a previously passed leaf, but lower-layer evidence must only be reopened with a contradictory boundary trace or targeted replay result.
The generated AxiDdrTop elaboration evidence could be mistaken for board wrapper readiness; board AXI/DDR planning must consume only the final single-layer readiness handoff, not skip ahead.
If detailed boundary rows are needed by downstream auditors, they must be requested as handoff artifacts rather than inferred absent from this compact role slice.

edges: failed leaf or layer gate -> failure_slice_localization -> targeted_replay -> causal_repair_context_pack

No hardware, Vivado, board-runtime, or liveness-only functional pass is claimed.
